joi_block.name: Scenario
joi_block.script:
triggered_v := false
if (triggered_v == true) {
wait until(not (all(#AirQualitySensor).airQualitySensor_carbonDioxide >=| 900))
    triggered_v = false
}
wait until(all(#AirQualitySensor).airQualitySensor_carbonDioxide >=| 900)
all(#Valve).valve_close()
triggered_v = true

precision_reasoning: confirmed ir_gt + binding_gt; no NL mapping
command_kor: 이산화탄소 농도가 900ppm 이상이 될때마다 벨브를 닫아줘.
command_eng: Each time the carbon dioxide level reaches 900ppm or higher, close the valve.
